title: A site's config redirects www to its apex production host with a 301
description:
Requested for Humorus (HUM board): https://www.thehallucinator.ai must answer 301 to https://thehallucinator.ai/ keeping path and query, from the site's own config, through the app-shell stack, no AWS ids in Git. Existing cards cover only the reader app's www (PPY-fe42eb, closed) and Anth.us's own cutover (PPY-a8cd76); nothing covers a CMS-hosted apex. PR: https://github.com/AnthusAI/Papyrus/pull/1560 (cms.wwwRedirect).

```gherkin
Feature: www redirects permanently to an apex production host

  Scenario: An apex production host gets a www sub-domain and a 301 rule
    Given a site config with cms.domainName "example.test", no cms.domainPrefix and cms.wwwRedirect true
    When the app shell template is synthesized
    Then the domain association has sub-domains "" and "www", both on the main branch
    And the app has a custom rule from "https://www.example.test" to "https://example.test" with status 301

  Scenario: Without the flag nothing changes
    Given the same site config without cms.wwwRedirect
    Then the template has only the apex sub-domain and no www rule
```
